name: reachability
description: REACHABILITY ratchet. `tsc`, the test suite and every existing lint gate check TYPES and BEHAVIOUR; nothing checked whether a thing is REACHED. CLAUDE.md names 'built but unwired' as this repo's single most common defect, and every instance (services/lateFees, services/respa/earlyIntervention, calculateFlipAnalysis, taxSaleAuctions/taxSaleListings, achMandateSetup/achAutopayRun, rental_units.kind='pad', routes-contract-chain.ts, the rent-roll importer's unitKind arg) shipped GREEN and was found hours later by a manual audit. This converts that recurring audit into CI. Four counts, each strictly down-only: exports in server/services|jobs with no production call site; pgTables with no writer; pgTables with no reader; routes-*.ts never mounted. THE CHEAPEST WAY TO SATISFY THIS GATE IS DELETION — the north star is a smaller codebase, and every reduction must be locked in by the commit that earned it (a stale-high baseline FAILS, same as `as-any`).

allowlist.reason: Read by compare-and-swap, not by SELECT. server/jobs/scheduler.ts acquires the single-flight lease with `UPDATE job_locks SET ... WHERE jobName = ? AND (expiresAt < now OR lockedBy = me) RETURNING id` — the WHERE clause IS the read and the RETURNING row is the answer. A separate SELECT-then-UPDATE would reintroduce exactly the race the lock exists to prevent, so this table can never grow a reader the linter's `.from(`/`db.query.` patterns can see. Structural blind spot, not dead weight.

Opt-out keyword set, reached in production intra-module by detectOptSignal (same file), which smsService.ts and tcpaCompliance.ts call on every inbound SMS. The reachability linter credits only CROSS-module production consumers, so an intra-module-reached export in an otherwise-wired module reads as dead — the same structural blind spot as job_locks. Also data-driven-tested directly (tests/unit/optOutDetection.test.ts iterates the set). Verified reached, not dead; delete this entry if a real cross-module consumer ever appears.

Single-parcel screening entry point, reached in production intra-module by screenParcels (same file), which preMailDedupe.ts calls on the live campaign pre-mail path (server/services/preMailDedupe.ts:252). The linter's cross-module-only heuristic cannot see intra-module reach, so it reads as dead inside a wired module. Also the primary directly-unit-tested surface (tests/unit/parcelScreening.test.ts). Verified reached, not dead; delete this entry if a cross-module consumer ever appears.

Pure spend-saved helper (disqualified count × cost-per-piece, clamped to a non-negative integer), reached in production intra-module by screenParcels (same file) → preMailDedupe.ts on the live campaign path. The cross-module-only reachability heuristic misses the intra-module call; the clamp/round edges are directly unit-tested (tests/unit/parcelScreening.test.ts). Verified reached, not dead; delete this entry if a cross-module consumer ever appears.
